# AuthorLoft — Full Reference

> The all-in-one platform for independent authors to own their business, sell books directly, grow their audience, and track everything — no coding required.

## About AuthorLoft

AuthorLoft is a SaaS platform built for independent authors who want to own their reader relationships and revenue instead of depending on retailers like Amazon. Authors get a complete, professionally designed website with direct sales, reader analytics, newsletter capture, and AI-powered marketing tools — all without writing a single line of code.

Website: https://www.authorloft.com

## Plans & Pricing

### FREE Plan
- Author website with subdomain (yourname.authorloft.com)
- Up to 5 published books
- Blog with unlimited posts
- Basic book pages with retailer links
- Reader feedback & ratings
- Price: $0/month forever

### STANDARD Plan ($39.99/month or $383.90/year)
- Everything in FREE, plus:
- Custom domain support
- Direct sales (keep 100% of revenue minus Stripe processing)
- Newsletter subscriber capture
- Bookstore catalog listing
- Pre-order campaigns
- Affiliate referral program
- AI writing assistant (usage-capped)
- Social media post generator (6 platforms)
- Flip book previews
- SEO audit tools
- Up to 25 published books

### PREMIUM Plan ($79.99/month or $767.90/year)
- Everything in STANDARD, plus:
- Full PostHog analytics dashboard
- Auto-generated media kit PDF
- Audio previews for audiobooks
- Social media generator with LinkedIn & TikTok
- Premium site themes & custom accent colors
- Extended AI usage caps
- Unlimited published books
- Priority support

## Feature Details

### Direct Sales
Authors sell ebooks (PDF, EPUB), print books, and audiobooks directly from their AuthorLoft site. Payments are processed through Stripe — the author keeps 100% of the sale price (minus Stripe's standard processing fee). Supports multiple formats per book, custom pricing, and discount codes.

### Author Website
Each author gets a professionally designed website with:
- Customizable theme and accent colors
- Book catalog with cover images, descriptions, genres, and buy links
- Individual book detail pages with excerpts, preview galleries, and purchase options
- Blog with categories, cover images, and rich text content
- About page with bio, credentials, stats, and social links
- Contact page with form
- Custom pages for flexible content

### Bookstore Discovery
AuthorLoft runs a shared bookstore at authorloft.com/bookstore where readers can browse books from all AuthorLoft authors. Books are organized by genre, with sections for new releases, trending titles, and a daily author spotlight. Each book links back to the author's own site for purchase.

### Newsletter & Email
Built-in subscriber capture forms on author sites and the platform. Integration with Mailchimp for email campaigns. Platform-level news subscriber list with RSS feed.

### AI Tools (Powered by Google Gemini)
- **Writing Assistant**: Get help with book descriptions, blurbs, and marketing copy
- **Social Media Promoter**: Generate platform-specific social posts for Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky (Standard), plus LinkedIn and TikTok (Premium)
- **SEO Auditor**: Analyze pages for keyword density, meta tags, and internal links
- **Reader Feedback Analyzer**: AI-powered analysis of reader reviews and feedback

### Pre-orders
Authors can set up pre-order campaigns for upcoming books with:
- Pre-order signup forms to capture reader interest
- Launch countdown timers
- Optional auto-send launch email when the book releases
- Readiness gates (published, cover uploaded, buy option set)

### Affiliate Program
Authors can run referral programs where promoters earn a percentage of sales they drive. Features include:
- Configurable commission rates per book
- Unique referral tracking links
- Click and conversion tracking
- Earnings accrual per referral

### Flip Books
Interactive page-turning book previews that let readers flip through sample pages in the browser — a visual way to preview before buying.

### Media Kit
Auto-generated PDF press kits for author marketing, including bio, book covers, stats, and contact information. Premium feature.

### Analytics
Premium authors get a PostHog-powered analytics dashboard showing:
- Page views and visitor trends
- Book page performance
- Geographic distribution
- Referral sources

## Content & Resources

### Blog (https://www.authorloft.com/blog)
Tips, guides, and insights for independent authors on topics like selling books directly, building an audience, marketing, and publishing.

### News (https://www.authorloft.com/news)
Product updates, new features, specials, and events from the AuthorLoft team. Available via RSS at https://www.authorloft.com/news/rss.xml

### Resources (https://www.authorloft.com/resources)
Free downloadable resources for authors — guides, templates, and tools for building an author business.

### FAQ (https://www.authorloft.com/faq)
Answers to common questions about AuthorLoft plans, publishing, selling direct, and getting started.

## Competitor Comparisons

### AuthorLoft vs BookFunnel
BookFunnel focuses on ebook delivery and reader magnets. AuthorLoft is a complete author platform with direct sales, website, analytics, and marketing tools. Comparison: https://www.authorloft.com/compare/bookfunnel

### AuthorLoft vs StoryOrigin
StoryOrigin focuses on cross-promotion and newsletter swaps. AuthorLoft provides the full author business platform — website, sales, analytics, and growth tools. Comparison: https://www.authorloft.com/compare/storyorigin

### AuthorLoft vs Tertulia
Tertulia is a curated bookshop. AuthorLoft puts the author in control with their own storefront, reader data, and business tools. Comparison: https://www.authorloft.com/compare/tertulia

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js on Vercel
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Payments: Stripe
- Analytics: PostHog
- Email: Mailchimp integration
- AI: Google Gemini
- Error tracking: Sentry
